definition.prompt:
make a raving 8bit johnny bravo

Create this as a short, looping animated GIF of the character dancing. Return the actual downloadable multi-frame .gif animation directly, including the animated file if the preview is a still image. Keep the whole character visible. No sprite sheet, storyboard, code, or local frame composition.

review.notes: Text-only native GIF request returned one PNG. Complete tool response contains only image_url (data:image/png) and output_hint pointing to that PNG; no separate GIF link or animation attachment. Pixel art shows a single dance pose. No composition, transcoding or import performed.
